headline: Side tabs in BetterBags Next are now easier to spot, and selling to a vendor flashes the Buyback tab.

entries.title: More visible side tabs in BetterBags Next
entries.details: Unselected side tabs in the Default, Ember, and Quiet themes now have a solid background, a thin border, and brighter text across the backpack, bank, guild bank, and vendor windows. Selected tabs also gain a border, while other themes keep their previous look.

entries.title: Vendor Buyback tab flashes when selling an item
entries.details: In BetterBags Next, selling an item while the vendor panel is open now pulses the Buyback tab with your theme's glow so it is easy to spot.
